items.label: MA-AG civil: Venturcap Investment Group (JD Byrider franchise)
items.detail: Consent judgment in Suffolk Superior Court on deceptive sales of defective used cars by the Massachusetts JD Byrider franchise; date is the announcement date. Pays $1.5 million, half used to reduce consumers' loan payments; separate option to cancel repossession debts is not counted. Cash-only rule applied 2026-10-11: amount changed from 1,500,000 to 750,000; the part not counted is listed in data/manual/excluded-amounts.csv as xa-017.

excluded_amounts.reason: Release: "Pay $1.5 million, of which half will be used to reduce ongoing payments for consumers with active loans" held by the dealer; it also offers to "cancel outstanding debts" after repossession (not valued). Counted: the other half, $750,000. Not counted: the loan payment reductions.
excluded_amounts.category_label: Debt relief, loan modification or account credits
